name: overleaf-tools
description: Work on LaTeX manuscripts that live on Overleaf: read the review comments and tracked changes that the git bridge does not carry, keep each theorem with its proof, each TikZ figure and each section in a file of its own, with the section files numbered in the order of the paper and one sentence per line, cite with cleveref rather than a typed name, and block reads and edits of the files that changed on Overleaf until the clone pulls them.
